studentPrivacy.title: Student information on public screens
studentPrivacy.subtitle: Scoreboards, ribbons, scorebugs and shared athlete pages are public. Decide what they may show about your students.
studentPrivacy.howItWorks: At a school, public screens show teams, jersey numbers, scores and stats — but no student names and no photos — until an administrator confirms the statements below. A family's directory opt-out always hides that student.
studentPrivacy.notLegalAdvice: This is not legal advice. Check each statement against your district's own FERPA directory-information notice and media-release policy before you confirm it.
studentPrivacy.banner: Student names and photos are hidden on public screens until an admin confirms your directory-information policy.
studentPrivacy.photosBanner: Student photos stay hidden on public screens until an admin confirms your photo-release policy.

photos.heading: Student photos
photos.shown: Shown only for students marked "Photo release on file"

statement.names: Our annual FERPA notice designates athletes' names and participation in officially recognized sports as directory information, and we record every family's directory-information opt-out in VenueOS before a student's name is shown on a public screen.
statement.photos: We have a signed photo / media release on file for every student we mark "Photo release on file" in VenueOS, and only those students' photos may be shown on a public screen.

studentPrivacy.confirmCheck: I confirm this statement is true for {org}.

roster.policyNote: Your school's policy hides students' names and photos on public screens. These switches can only hide more.
roster.policyPhotosNote: Your school's policy hides students' photos on public screens. These switches can only hide more.
